mid.label: Mid
mid.description: Midpoint of best yes-bid and yes-ask. Untradeable reference price.

spreadCents.label: Spread
spreadCents.description: Best ask − best bid (¢). Wide spreads = poor liquidity; prefer postOnly.

crossed.label: Crossed book
crossed.description: Transient book state (yesBid + noBid > 100). Do not treat mid as tradeable.

avgKalshiVolumeFp.label: Avg volume (Fp)
avgKalshiVolumeFp.description: Mean resolved Kalshi contract volume over trading appearances (player_profiles). Not poly; not a single-tick kalshi_volume.

yesPriceCents.label: Yes price ¢
yesPriceCents.description: Limit price for YES contracts, 1–99¢. NO price = 100 − yes.

balanceCents.label: Balance
balanceCents.description: Available-to-trade cash. Does not include value locked in open positions.

portfolioValueCents.label: Portfolio value
portfolioValueCents.description: Current mark value of all held positions, separate from cash balance.

position.label: Position
position.description: Signed contracts: positive = long YES, negative = long NO (Kalshi convention).

exposureCents.label: Exposure
exposureCents.description: Cash at risk in this market at current marks.

realizedPnlCents.label: Realized P&L
realizedPnlCents.description: Locked-in profit/loss from closed trades in this market.

feesPaidCents.label: Fees paid
feesPaidCents.description: Total exchange fees paid in this market, all time.

remainingCount.label: Remaining
remainingCount.description: Contracts still working on the book (not yet filled or canceled).

fillCount.label: Fill count
fillCount.description: Contracts already executed from this order.

isTaker.label: Taker
isTaker.description: True = crossed the spread (taker fee); false = rested on book (maker fee, lower).

feeCents.label: Fee ¢
feeCents.description: Exchange fee on this fill. Maker < taker — postOnly orders target maker fees.

postOnly.label: Post-only
postOnly.description: Maker-first: order rests on book or is rejected; never crosses the spread.

dryRun.label: Dry-run
dryRun.description: Simulated order — no funds move, no API write. Live requires explicit opt-in.

shadowMinSignals.label: Shadow min signals
shadowMinSignals.description: Gate: minimum shadow signals before a program may graduate to pilot.

killBrierDriftPct.label: Kill Brier drift %
killBrierDriftPct.description: Gate: kill program if Brier score drifts this % above baseline.

graduationMinRealizedEdgeCentsPerFill.label: Graduation edge ¢/fill
graduationMinRealizedEdgeCentsPerFill.description: Gate: realized edge per fill needed for pilot→live.

league.label: League
league.description: Professional circuit derived from Kalshi series (ATP, WTA, Challenger, ITF).

surface.label: Surface
surface.description: Court type: Hard, Clay, Grass, Carpet (from event or tournament seed).

round.label: Round
round.description: Match round within the tournament (R16, QF, SF, F, …).

gender.label: Gender
gender.description: Competition gender classification on the desk export.

age_group.label: Age group
age_group.description: Age band when present (junior/senior); often empty on tour.

match_uuid.label: Match UUID
match_uuid.description: Stable match identity for desk joins.

timestamp.label: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Snapshot capture time for the desk row.

player_a.label: Player A
player_a.description: Side A player display name on the desk row.

player_b.label: Player B
player_b.description: Side B player display name on the desk row.

title.label: Title
title.description: Match / event title string on the desk export.

kalshi_mu.label: Kalshi µ
kalshi_mu.description: Kalshi mid (implied probability cents) on the desk snapshot.

kalshi_spread.label: Kalshi spread
kalshi_spread.description: Kalshi bid–ask spread on the desk snapshot.

kalshi_volume.label: Kalshi volume
kalshi_volume.description: Kalshi contract volume on the desk tick (not player-profile average).

poly_mid.label: Poly mid
poly_mid.description: Polymarket mid price, cents; null when venue absent.

poly_volume.label: Poly volume
poly_volume.description: Polymarket volume USD; null = venue absent, 0 = joined with zero trades.

pinny_no_vig.label: Pinnacle no-vig
pinny_no_vig.description: Pinnacle no-vig probability in cents; null when unavailable.

elo_prob.label: Elo prob
elo_prob.description: Elo win probability for player A (0–1); interpret with elo_source.

elo_source.label: Elo source
elo_source.description: model | fallback_50 | missing — provenance of elo_prob.

blend_fair_cents.label: Blend fair ¢
blend_fair_cents.description: Blended fair price in cents (core priced output).

eff_edge.label: Eff edge
eff_edge.description: Effective edge vs blend (cents); tick-bound, can drift.

liquidity_ok.label: Liquidity OK
liquidity_ok.description: Desk liquidity gate (necessary, not sufficient for tradable).

total_volume_usd.label: Total volume USD
total_volume_usd.description: Combined venue volume in USD for the match snapshot.

multi_venue.label: Multi-venue
multi_venue.description: Whether more than one venue is joined on the row.

arb_hint.label: Arb hint
arb_hint.description: Directional arb signal (kalshi-cheap | poly-cheap | none | watch).

arb_actionable.label: Arb actionable
arb_actionable.description: Hard arb gate (net edge > 0 on real venue-vs-venue).

rps_flag.label: RPS flag
rps_flag.description: Research process signal flag on the desk row.

graph_divergence.label: Graph divergence
graph_divergence.description: Graph/model divergence indicator on the desk export.

export_note.label: Export note
export_note.description: Per-row provenance string (e.g. mock pinny caveat).

playerProfiles.label: Player profiles
playerProfiles.description: Derived from event-store player_profiles (SSOT). Rebuild: bun run tennis:profiles:build.

lastSeenAtMs.label: Last seen
lastSeenAtMs.description: Epoch millis of latest event start for this player. Capped ≤ now. Event-store ms.

profilesSource.label: Profiles source
profilesSource.description: warehouse = rows from event-store; seed = unavailable / fixture path.

coverage.label: Coverage
coverage.description: Data completeness for a tour/surface slice (events with books, links, scores).

surfaceEdge.label: Surface edge
surfaceEdge.description: Dampened percentage-point edge from each player's historical surface win rates vs the match surface.

ui.events.filter.reset.label: Reset filters

ui.live_board.title.label: Tennis board

ui.live_board.scanner.label: Scanner

ui.live_board.divergence.label: Divergence

ui.live_board.edge_score.label: Edge score

ui.live_board.model_suspect.label: Model suspect
ui.live_board.model_suspect.description: Flag when model inputs are stale, incomplete, or conflict with market consensus.

ui.events.filter.tournament.label: Tournament
ui.events.filter.tournament.description: Filter matches by tournament / competition name.

ui.events.filter.country.label: Country
ui.events.filter.country.description: Filter by tournament or player nationality code/name.

ui.events.filter.when.label: When
ui.events.filter.when.description: Time window filter: live, today, next 24h, this week.

ui.events.filter.liquidity.label: Liquidity
ui.events.filter.liquidity.description: Filter by quote presence: priced or actively trading.

ui.events.filter.min_vol.label: Min 24h vol
ui.events.filter.min_vol.description: Minimum trailing volume gate for board rows (desk liquidity).

ui.events.filter.min_surface_edge.label: Min surface edge
ui.events.filter.min_surface_edge.description: Minimum surface-edge points required to keep a match on the board.

ui.sort.events.label: Sort

ui.filter.unclassified.label: Unclassified

ui.warehouse.coverage.label: Coverage
ui.warehouse.coverage.description: Data completeness badge: Kalshi-only, Polymarket-only, or hybrid.

ui.warehouse.poly_link.label: Poly
ui.warehouse.poly_link.description: Polymarket market link status: linked or unlinked.

ui.warehouse.event_status.label: Event status
ui.warehouse.event_status.description: Match lifecycle: Scheduled, Live, or Ended.

ui.warehouse.fleet_count.label: Events
ui.warehouse.fleet_count.description: Number of matches in the current filtered view.

ui.warehouse.fleet_volume.label: Total volume
ui.warehouse.fleet_volume.description: Aggregated volume across the filtered match set.

composite.scanner.label: Scanner signal
composite.scanner.description: Abstract scanner / divergence-alert concept used by live board UI.

alert.poly_dropout.label: Poly Dropout
alert.poly_dropout.description: kalshiOnly % exceeds threshold (>30% default) for N logger cycles. Polymarket matching failing.

alert.volume_gap.label: Volume Gap
alert.volume_gap.description: midOnly exceeds threshold (>10 default) for N cycles. Many mids but zero volume — stale volume_fp.

alert.feed_frozen.label: Poly Feed Frozen
alert.feed_frozen.description: polyMatched=0 for N consecutive cycles. Polymarket feed completely frozen.

alert.divergence.label: Price Divergence
alert.divergence.description: Kalshi mid deviates from Poly implied prob > divergence-cents (15¢). Cross-venue mispricing.

alert.resolution.label: Alert Resolution
alert.resolution.description: Auto-sent when active alert clears. Includes duration, replies original, clears debounce.

alert.delivery.label: Alert Delivery
alert.delivery.description: Telegram (HTML, threaded, keyboard CRITICAL), Discord/Slack webhook, console stderr.

codes.DEP: deposit — funds in via Kalshi web/bank rails; reconciled, never API-initiated
codes.WDL: withdrawal — funds out via Kalshi web/bank rails; reconciled, never API-initiated
codes.FILL: fill — executed quantity against an order; has is_taker + fee_cost
codes.BAL: balance — available-to-trade cents; portfolio_value is separate
codes.FEE: fee — taker or maker, cents (taker_fees / maker_fees / fee_cost)
codes.BOOK: orderbook snapshot — bids/asks in yes-cents, integer levels
codes.MILE: Kalshi milestone — groups related event tickers
codes.RUN: research run — one discovery+score sweep, id = UTC timestamp
codes.SHDW: shadow signal — simulated decision, hash-chained in shadow-log.jsonl
codes.ALERT: pipeline alert — fired by price-logger when feed quality degrades
codes.RESV: alert resolution — auto-sent when active alert conditions clear

units.cents: integer cents, 1–99 for prices; canonical money unit everywhere
units.dollarsFp: fixed-point dollar string e.g. "0.5600" — wire only, parse via dollarsToCents
units.countFp: fixed-point contract string e.g. "10.00" — fractional flagged, not orderable
units.atMs: epoch milliseconds — canonical time unit (suffix AtMs)
units.unixSec: unix seconds — wire only (updated_ts, ts); multiply by 1000 at boundary
